Puerto Madero is Buenos Aires’ youngest neighbourhood and it has experienced quite the makeover! The former docklands district is now home to glass high rises, riverfront promenades, and former red brick warehouses that hold gelato shops, cafes and restaurants. It feels modern and polished, yet you still catch glimpses of its working-port past in the towering yellow cranes and the old docks lining the water.
